text:
anya: Heads-up — we got two enterprise asks this week for a paid Priority Lane add-on (guaranteed throughput / routing priority). Customers want predictable latency under heavy load and the ability to burst. Thoughts on caps vs commitments?

matt: Important revenue opp but also risk. If we guarantee hard SLA we need a clear overage/billing model. softcaps feel safer.

sara: From infra side, hard guarantees mean reserved capacity or pinned instances. That raises cost significantly unless they commit to a reserve. We can simulate with a token-based reservation system.

raj: Customer A asked for a "500 concurrent reqs" guarantee for peak hours. Customer B wants a small commit but unlimited burst above it if capacity. Both asked specifically about contractual language.

anya: Proposal idea: two SKUs — "Priority Reserve" (hard-guarantee, monthly reserved capacity, higher price) and "Priority Burst" (soft-priority, surcharge for burst usage). Launch criteria: a) pricing + legal sample clause, b) implementation proof-of-concept on dedicated pool, c) clear telemetry in Console.

matt: Agree. Also recommend a minimum commit (e.g., $X/month) for Reserve to ensure unit economics. For Burst, we need a per-usage surcharge and a cap that auto-throttles to protect standard customers.

sara: Technical constraints/notes: we can implement a Node affinity + routing weight for Reserve. Burst needs preemption policy and throttles. For billing, we can emit a "priority_token" metric per request. Example config: 

```json
{
  "sku": "priority-burst",
  "commitment": 0,
  "burst_surcharge_per_1k": "5USD",
  "burst_softcap_per_min": 1000
}
```

sara: Also need a fallback path: if priority pool exhausted, automatically route to public pool with a note and a compensation credit path.

raj: Sales feedback: customers prefer simple language. They asked if burst surcharge can be amortized into a monthly cap so it doesn't look like unpredictable bills.

matt: We can offer an optional "burst allowance" add-on (prepaid credits) at a discount. That matches sales ask and protects us from open-ended exposure.

anya: Ok action items: matt to draft pricing tiers and commit floor, sara to prototype routing + metrics, raj to gather sample contract language from customers, I'll draft launch checklist and success metrics. Target internal beta in 6 weeks.

billing-bot: Sample quota/metric emitted: priority_token.count = 3421, priority_throttle.events = 8. Invoice preview for Reserve SKU available at /billing/preview/PRIORITY_RESERVE

anya: Quick question — what do we need as minimum telemetry to decide GA? Latency p50/p95 for priority vs baseline, number of preemptions, revenue delta, and customer satisfaction from pilot. If we don't hit thresholds, rollback to Burst-only.

matt: +1. add cost-per-request for reserved capacity. Also define a churn risk threshold (if pilot increases churn we abort).

sara: I'll add dashboard widgets for p50/p95, preemption rate, and priority_token burn rate. Will also add an experiment flag to isolate traffic.

anya: Thanks all. I'll sync with legal on sample SLA language today and post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
